verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents automation surfaces: AgentOS skills, multi-step workflows, the CLI for scripting repeatable tasks, and sandbox testing. Nothing in the pack shows a first-party way to version, review, or roll back those automations. The CLI scripts and sandbox are user-side or adjacent building blocks, not automation version control, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
